free_tier.stated: Tinc is a peer-to-peer VPN daemon that supports VPNs with an arbitrary number of nodes. Instead of configuring tunnels, you give Tinc the location and public key of a few nodes in the VPN.

egress.terms: No hosted allowance exists: the software runs on a host a user supplies.; ingress: tcp+udp

binding_note: software only: no hosted endpoint is offered, so any egress it provides begins with a host that a user must get from a compute provider. Peer-to-peer VPN daemon; needs nodes.
